escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection — 8 CVEs in Source/Backend
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker controls template input via AST type confusion or partial-block tampering to execute arbitrary JavaScript in build pipeline context
escalations.impact: Remote code execution in build/CI environment; supply chain compromise risk

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution in Orchestrator — 9 CVEs (BLOCKING)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker submits crafted protobuf message → prototype pollution → RCE chain in orchestrator; orchestrator runs agent pipelines so code execution = full pipeline hijack
escalations.impact: Full RCE in orchestrator; pipeline hijack; lateral movement potential to all services reachable from orchestrator network

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer hardcoded to Source/ and E2E/ — false failures for portal and platform
backlog.detail: source_dirs = ["Source", "E2E"] — portal/ and platform/ never scanned; all 69 portal FRs and all FR-TMP-* show as 0% in spec-drift-report.json
backlog.recommendation: Add "portal" and "platform" to source_dirs, or add per-plan config override

backlog.title: FR-dependency-api-types STILL OPEN — blocked_by missing + as any casts
backlog.detail: Neither UpdateFeatureRequestInput nor UpdateBugInput has blocked_by?: string[]; DependencyPicker uses as any on both PATCH calls creating type-safety gap
backlog.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both types in portal/Shared/api.ts; remove as any casts from DependencyPicker.tsx:291,293

backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed STILL OPEN — no seed.ts in portal/Backend/src/database/
backlog.detail: Fresh deployments have dependency UI wired but no example relationships. Spec requires idempotent seeding of BUG-0010 blocked_by BUG-0003/0004/0005/0006/0007 etc.
backlog.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with idempotent dependency seeding; wire into portal/Backend/src/index.ts after DB init

backlog.title: Direct DB calls in teamDispatches.ts route handler — service layer bypassed
backlog.detail: db.prepare(...).all() and db.prepare(...).run() called directly in route handler bodies. Violates CLAUDE.md: No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.
backlog.recommendation: Extract teamDispatchService.ts with listDispatches(db, {team, limit}) and createDispatch(db, data); route handler calls service only

backlog.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS (CVSS 7.5) — crafted routes hang orchestrator
backlog.detail: Attacker can craft routes with many parameters to trigger ReDoS, hanging the orchestrator HTTP server
backlog.fix_command: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update path-to-regexp (may require npm update express)

backlog.title: FR-dependency-frontend-tests: 2 portal test files missing
backlog.detail: Source/Frontend/tests/components/DependencySection.test.tsx exists but covers workflow-engine app component, not portal component. Portal DependencySection and BlockedBadge are untested.
backlog.recommendation: Create both files with // Verifies: FR-dependency-section and FR-dependency-blocked-badge traceability comments

backlog.title: FR-TMP-008 has no Verifies comment — Dockerfile.worker prerequisites untraced
backlog.detail: FR-TMP-008 specifies Dockerfile.worker must have gh CLI, Playwright installable, GITHUB_TOKEN passthrough. No traceability comment. Sole gap in tiered-merge-pipeline spec.
backlog.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-008 to Dockerfile.worker section. Confirm gh CLI presence.

backlog.title: teamDispatches/TeamsPage/RepoSelector have no spec FR — untracked implementation
backlog.detail: All three recently added (within 14 days), no // Verifies: comments, no FR in any specification. Violates spec-first principle.
backlog.recommendation: Write FR(s) in Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md and back-fill traceability comments, OR document why exempt in a spec note

backlog.title: Vite Path Traversal in .map handling (CVSS 5.3) — dev server only
backlog.fix_command: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite (major bump 5→6, test for breaking changes)

backlog.title: Vitest transitive vulnerabilities (inherited from vite@5.4.0)
backlog.fix_command: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite (cascades to vitest)

backlog.title: PostCSS XSS via </style> injection (CVSS 6.1)
backlog.fix_command: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite (cascades to postcss)

backlog.title: Esbuild CSRF/SSRF in dev server (CVSS 5.3)
backlog.fix_command: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite (cascades to esbuild)

backlog.title: Brace-expansion ReDoS — zero-step sequence causes process hang (CVSS 6.5)
@protobufjs/utf8 overlong UTF-8 decoding bypass (CVSS 5.3)
backlog.fix_command: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs (cascades to @protobufjs/utf8)

backlog.title: eslint-disable for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 3 production files
backlog.detail: Suppressing exhaustive-deps is a common source of stale closure bugs
backlog.recommendation: Review whether suppression is correct; if intentional add explanatory comment

backlog.title: playwright.pipeline.config.ts lacks Verifies comment for FR-TMP-003
backlog.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-003 to the file

cross_reference_map.impact: Resolves 4 CVEs (path traversal, vitest chain, PostCSS XSS, esbuild CSRF) in one command
Resolves RCE + UTF-8 bypass; unblocks all deployments

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Write spec FR(s) in Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md + extract teamDispatchService.ts
cross_reference_map.impact: Closes architecture violation and scope-creep finding simultaneously

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add blocked_by types + create seed.ts + create 2 portal test files
